thread:
yasmin: Hi all  Yasmin here (Product Designer, Growth). First week checklist Qs: 1) I can't duplicate the Growth component library in Figma (permission?), 2) need read access to Amplitude dashboards for activation funnels, 3) how do I request a feature-flag for a prototype on staging, 4) who pairs on accessibility audits and where's the checklist? TL;DR: perms + analytics + flags + a11y flow.

theo: welcome Yasmin! :tada: For Figma component duplication ping @design-ops or drop the file link. If it's a library-publish setting we can flip it.

yasmin: file: https://www.figma.com/file/GROWTHKIT/rdw-growth-components ; email: yasmin@redwood.com

theo: invited you as Editor on Growth Components. If you still can't duplicate, check the published library settings (we often keep "Restrict editing" on).

yasmin: seeing the file, can duplicate now 44c thanks.

nate: hey Yasmin  Nate from Data. For Amplitude request the dashboard link you need and your email; we'll grant read and map the event names to the roadmap metrics. Also add which cohorts (new users vs invited users) you care about.

yasmin: want Activation Funnel -> new_user_signups -> activation_complete. email: yasmin@redwood.com. Cohorts: new users (signup <30d) + invited users.

nate: sent read access. FYI we keep canonical event docs in Notion: https://redwood.notion.site/analytics-events. If you want a custom chart ping me and i'll stitch it into the Growth dashboard.

yasmin: GREAT. Feature flags: i'm prototyping a permission bump that toggles a lightweight onboarding toast. How do i request a flag on staging?

claire: Claire from Eng Platform here. For quick prototyping we have a self-serve feature-flag form: https://redwood.tools/flags-request. Fill name, env=staging, toggle owner (your email), and desired TTL. For prod flags we require a rollout plan + kill-switch. If you want to test immediately DM me and i'll spin a short-lived flag.

yasmin: will do the form. also can we surface the flag in the Design handoff template? currently the Handoff checklist doesn't mention flags.

theo: good call. i just updated the Product Handoff template in Notion (Product > Handoff) and added a Feature Flags checkbox + a sample LaunchDarkly name. You should be able to duplicate the doc and link the flag id.

yasmin: accessibility audit: who runs it and where's the checklist? i want to do a quick WCAG pass before handoff.

claire: we have an Accessibility guild. start with the A11Y checklist in Notion: https://redwood.notion.site/accessibility-checklist (color contrast, keyboard nav, aria labels, focus states). Also ping @a11y-reviewers to volunteer. If you want an engineer pair use the "Design Pair" rota and request 2 hours in the week.

yasmin: added a11y review to my handoff checklist. Can someone pair on first pass for keyboard nav?

nate: I can join a quick session tomorrow at 11am PT (I do keyboard nav checks from the analytics side).

claire: i'll slot an engineer from Eng Platform for Thurs 2pm PT for implementation details.

yasmin: perfect. one more: mentorship/buddy for design onboarding? Where do new designers get paired?

theo: we have a New Hires buddy program. I'll assign you a buddy (usually a senior designer) and schedule a 30-min intro. Expect an invite from me.

onboarding-bot: Yasmin has been added to: Product Team, Design - Growth, Accessibility Guild. Onboarding checklist updated (Tasks: confirm Figma access, request Amplitude read, file flag request, schedule a11y pair).

yasmin: thanks all  super helpful. i'll fill the flag form and post the handoff draft in #prod-design-review.

claire: small tip for staging flags: use TTL=72h for prototype flags so they auto-expire if not cleaned up. Also include `clientVariation` in the flag metadata for the front-end to pick up.

yasmin: noted. example snippet i'll add to the handoff doc:
```
feature_flag: growth_onboarding_toast
env: staging
ttl: 72h
clientVariation: true
owner: yasmin@redwood.com
```

nate: perfect. once you post the handoff i'll link the Amplitude funnels and a sample experiment metric set.

yasmin: posting now. thanks everyone, see you in the critique tomorrow 10am PT.

design-ops-bot: Added Yasmin to Growth Components, Design - Growth team. Notion templates updated with Feature Flags checkbox.

yasmin: closing the loop  all set, appreciate the speedy onboarding help!"
